description: Trusted repository snapshots and pull request diff for prepare-review tests. Files are arrays of physical lines, each with its exact terminator. `diff` is the authoritative context a future transport supplies: baseCommit is the verified old-side (merge-base) commit and headCommit is the reviewed commit. Patches are cross-checked against git diff by the test suite.

src/labels.js:
export const OK = '✅ ok';
export const PARTY = '🎉 party';

patch:
diff --git a/lib/legacy.js b/lib/legacy.js
deleted file mode 100644
index 3333333..0000000
--- a/lib/legacy.js
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1 +0,0 @@
-module.exports = 'legacy';
